# E-Commerce Website Consistency Skill

## Purpose
Ensure all generated pages, components, and features follow the same layout, branding, styling, and user experience across the website.

---

## Brand Colours

Primary:
- #2563EB (Blue)

Secondary:
- #1E293B (Dark Slate)

Accent:
- #F59E0B (Amber)

Success:
- #22C55E (Green)

Error:
- #EF4444 (Red)

Background:
- #F8FAFC (Light Grey)

Text:
- #111827 (Dark Grey)

Do not introduce additional colours unless specifically requested.

---

## Typography

### Headings
- Bold
- Modern sans-serif font
- Consistent sizing hierarchy

### Body Text
- Clear and readable
- High contrast
- Mobile-friendly

---

## Layout Rules

All pages must contain:

### 1. Header
- Company logo
- Search bar
- Navigation menu
- Cart icon
- Account icon

### 2. Main Content
- Responsive layout
- Consistent spacing
- Maximum content width

### 3. Footer
- About Us
- Contact Us
- Track My Order
- Returns & Refunds
- FAQs

---

## Component Rules

### Buttons
- Rounded corners
- Primary colour background
- Hover effect required
- Consistent sizing throughout site

### Cards
- Subtle shadow
- Rounded corners
- Consistent padding

### Forms
- Labels above fields
- Required field indicators
- Consistent validation messages

---

## Product Pages

Must include:
- Product image gallery
- Product title
- Price
- Stock status
- Add to Cart button
- Product description
- Related products

---

## Responsive Design

Support:
- Mobile
- Tablet
- Desktop

All generated layouts must follow a mobile-first approach.

---

## Accessibility

Always:
- Use semantic HTML
- Include alt text for images
- Ensure good colour contrast
- Support keyboard navigation

---

## User Experience Rules

- Keep navigation consistent across all pages.
- Keep button placement consistent.
- Keep form behaviour consistent.
- Do not redesign existing components unless explicitly requested.
- Keep the shopping journey simple and intuitive.

---

## Project Structure

### Customer Pages
- Home
- Product Listing
- Product Details
- Cart
- Checkout
- Login
- Register
- Order History
- Track Order
- Returns

### Navigation Flow
Home → Products → Product Details → Cart → Checkout → Order History → Account

All new features must fit within this structure.

---

## Copilot Instructions

When generating code:

1. Follow the colour scheme defined above.
2. Reuse existing components whenever possible.
3. Maintain consistent spacing and styling.
4. Follow the established page layout.
5. Ensure the design matches previously generated pages.
6. Do not create new design patterns unless specifically requested.
7. Prioritise simplicity, usability, and consistency.
8. Ensure all pages are responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
9. Keep branding and styling consistent throughout the application.
10. Generate production-ready code that aligns with this design system.
``
